messages:
Anya: Quick sync 1: we need to change how Console surfaces saved queries. Problem: model-scoped queries are polluting route dropdowns and confusing teams. Proposal: default-hide model-scoped saved queries at route-level and only show them when a route explicitly opts in.
Jules: I like the intent. Two immediate asks: what API will teams use to opt-in? and how do we measure impact?
Anya: API sketch: PATCH /api/saved_queries/{id} body: { "expose_to_route": true|false, "exposure_mode": "copy"|"link" }. Default for existing model-scoped rows = false.
Chris: For the UI, we should offer both a lightweight opt-in toggle on the route dropdown and a one-click migrate that copies the query into the route's saved queries. Copy should keep an origin pointer.
Priya: Important: if we hide by default, power users will mass-create copies which could increase token burn. We should show an estimated monthly token delta before copy. Also add a checkbox: "Notify team about duplicated queries".
Evan: Telemetry plan: emit events: saved_query.exposure_change, saved_query.exec (sampled), saved_query.copy. Add fields: query_id, prior_scope, new_scope, route_id, model_id, user_id, org_tier. Start exec sampling at 0.5% globally; increase to 5% during canary. We'll also record token_count per sampled exec.
Jules: Can we get a quick audit: how many model-scoped saved_queries were referenced from a route in last 60d? We need base rates before flipping anything.
Evan: I'll run a one-off job to count references in route_views and post a CSV. Also will add a Grafana dashboard showing: exposures over time, copy rate, average token per exec for copied vs original queries.
Chris: Backend constraints: adding expose_to_route flag across millions of rows could lock tables. We need a background migration that writes a new boolean column with default NULL then backfill in batches. Add an admin flag to run a dry-run to compute duplicates if we forced expose=true.
Anya: Good catch. Mike from infra suggested a non-blocking rollout: create column with no default, backfill in small windows, and only flip UI behavior via a feature flag. We'll gate feature flag to 10% of orgs for the canary.
Priya: UX microcopy: banner when a hidden model query is encountered in route context: "This saved query is scoped to the model and not visible to this route. Copy to route (recommended) — Estimated monthly token increase: ~X." Add a "learn more" link pointing to docs.
Evan: For the cost estimate, we'll compute: (avg_tokens_per_exec * avg_execs_per_day * 30) * model_cost_per_token. Use sampled execs to compute avg_tokens_per_exec. We'll return a 7d and 30d est.
Jules: Rollout checklist: 1) telemetry events + dashboard, 2) API change + db migration plan, 3) UI banner + opt-in toggle + copy flow, 4) canary 10% orgs -> monitor copy rate and token delta, 5) expand to 50% then GA.
Chris: Also add an admin API: GET /admin/saved_queries/exposure_audit?org_id=&preview=true that returns counts and example affected routes for auditing customers before opt-in.
Anya: Timeline: telemetry + admin audit job by Wed, API + background migration scoped by Fri, UI mock + copy flow by next Tue. Canary target next sprint (two weeks).
Evan: infra-bot: scheduled canary for feature-flag 'hide-model-queries-route' -> 2024-04-17 08:00 UTC for 10% orgs.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: feature hide-model-queries-route -> 2024-04-17T08:00:00Z, rollout: 10% orgs, sampling: execs@5% during canary.
Priya: One more ask: when we copy, keep a small backlink widget: "Copied from <origin name> — keep linked for upstream updates? [Unlink]" so teams know provenance.
Anya: OK action owners: Evan: telemetry + audit CSV + Grafana panel; Chris: db migration + admin API + backlink model; Jules: UI mock + microcopy + accessibility check; Priya: cost-copy messaging + product decision doc. Reconvene Friday for status.
Jules: noted. I'll push a first mock to the design board tonight.
Evan: starting telemetry PR now.
Anya: Thanks everyone. We'll watch for any edge cases in the admin audit and adjust sampling as needed.
